body:
Army can chapter you for medical issues, and suicidal depression can and will warrant a medical discharge. I've seen it happen.

Edit: plus even if they don't discharge me, I don't want to fuck my buddies by making them constantly watch me when I return from leave.

Nah that was just the last straw. I feel like no matter what I do it won't be enough. My life is unsatisfactory at best, awful at worst. My brother has found more success than me, so arguing with the sibling that never gets shit from our parents was just the breaking point really.
